title: MemesDreams
tagline: Create your own Memes Character in NFT + Coin & Manage the twitter content with ease
description: This project aims to create a platform where users can easily interact with our AI Agent -- MemesDreams, to not only generate their meme characters into NFTs but also turn these NFTs into a project with the help of the agent managing generated content that will be posted on Twitter/X.
how_its_made:
The project is built using the NextJS framework and deployed on Vercel. The agent interactions with the content generation where it be text or image, uses Amazon Nova, Amazon Bedrock and the Hyperbolic LLM.

AWS was perfect for the build because of the latest release of Amazon Nova. The image quality that it provides to the users are much more better than the other competitors in the market. We explored a lot on the AWS Sides of things
